blocks.html: Follow an existing route to your objective with on-screen distance, heading and turn cues.

slides.title: Start navigation on a route
slides.html: Select the route's navigation radial option, or tap its Navigation icon in the Routes listing. Navigation info then appears in the top left corner. (To build a route first, see Create Routes and use VNS.)

slides.title: Read the navigation info
slides.html: The bar shows distance, current speed and the next check point, for example Next: CP1 Continue Straight. Tap the top row of the display to collapse it and free up screen space.

slides.title: Cues, mute and units
slides.html: As you near a check point its cue shows; turn the volume up to hear voice cues, or tap the Mute icon to silence them. Tap the distance or speed to cycle units (mph, km/h, kn, m/s).

slides.title: Move between check points and end
slides.html: Use the arrows on either side of the info to step to the next or previous check point. Select the x to end navigation.

slides.title: Navigate tilted in 3D with billboards
slides.html: While navigating in 3D, a marker's attached image pops up as a billboard when you come within its render distance, then clears once you pass. Adjust it under Settings > Tool Preferences > Specific Tool Preferences > Route Preferences > Billboard Render Distance.

slides.title: Quick Nav to any point (bloodhound)
slides.html: Select the Quick Nav icon to bloodhound straight to any point, object or route. A pairing line is drawn and the lower left shows time, speed and distance to the next check point as you move.
